Bhakpa male rajy kamiti ki or se rajy sachiv manoj bhakt ne mang ki hai ki hemant sarkar jharkhand men vibhinn kanpniyon dvara aapurti kie ja rahe petrol ki svatantr janch ki vyavastha kare aur usmen ithenol ki vastavik matra ko sarvajnik kare.
